items.extra: se rendre compte de qch / que + proposition
items.fr: En partant, Paul [se rend compte] qu'il a oublié ses clés.
items.sen: As he leaves, Paul realizes that he has forgotten his keys.
items.szh: 出门时，保罗意识到自己忘了拿钥匙。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon man in a coat pauses at an open doorway, pulls his empty pockets outward and suddenly realizes he has forgotten his keys. Show the keys conspicuously resting on a nearby hallway table behind him, with his surprised face, empty pockets and the keys all large and easy to read; landscape 3:2, no text, letters, numerals, logos, symbols or watermarks.
items.hook: 出门一摸空口袋，才意识到忘了拿钥匙：se rendre compte。

items.fr: Malgré son bras plâtré, Hugo [s'en sort] seul en cuisine.
items.sen: Despite his arm being in a cast, Hugo manages on his own in the kitchen.
items.szh: 虽然一只胳膊打着石膏，雨果还是独自在厨房应付得来。
items.scene: A cheerful cartoon man with one arm resting safely in a cast has successfully prepared a colourful cold meal with his other hand. Centre him proudly setting the finished plate on a clear kitchen counter, with a few prepared vegetables nearby and no hot surfaces or sharp utensils visible. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 一只胳膊不方便，仍把饭做好：困难中也应付得来。

items.fr: Sans escabeau, Lina [se débrouille] pour attraper le pot.
items.sen: Without a stepladder, Lina finds a way to reach the jar.
items.szh: 没有折梯，莉娜自己想办法够到了罐子。
items.scene: A resourceful cartoon woman stands securely on the kitchen floor and uses long kitchen tongs to grasp a small jar on a high shelf. Make the improvised solution—the tongs reaching the jar—the large central focus, with no ladder or lettering on the jar. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 没有梯子就借助长夹子：自己想办法解决。

items.fr: Pendant son premier hiver, Lina [s'adapte] au froid en s'habillant chaudement.
items.sen: During her first winter, Lina adapts to the cold by dressing warmly.
items.szh: 在度过第一个冬天时，莉娜通过穿暖和的衣服来适应寒冷。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon woman adjusts to winter by pulling a thick colourful scarf around her layered coat, already wearing a knitted hat and mittens. Show her comfortably dressed in the foreground of a simple snowy doorway, with the clothing layers and purposeful action clearly visible. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 天气变冷，就调整穿着；s'adapter à 表示适应某种情况。

items.extra: se méfier de qn / de qch
items.fr: Le promeneur [se méfie] du chien qui garde le portail.
items.sen: The walker is wary of the dog guarding the gate.
items.szh: 散步的人对守着大门的狗保持警惕。
items.scene: A cartoon walker pauses at a respectful distance from a closed garden gate, looking cautiously at the watchful dog behind it. Centre the walker leaning slightly back with one cautious hand raised and the alert dog facing him; keep the dog calm, without bared teeth or threatening imagery. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 看到守门的狗，先留点距离：se méfier de，警惕。

items.fr: Pendant ses vacances, Léa [compte sur] sa sœur pour arroser ses plantes.
items.sen: During her holiday, Léa counts on her sister to water her plants.
items.szh: 度假期间，莱娅指望姐姐帮她给植物浇水。
items.scene: A cartoon woman ready to leave on holiday, with a suitcase and sunhat, gratefully entrusts a watering can to her sister beside several leafy houseplants. The sister confidently accepts the can and reaches toward the nearest pot, making her dependable help the central focus in a simple three-colour linocut composition.
items.hook: 出门度假，把植物托付给可靠的姐姐：compter sur，依靠、指望。

items.fr: Face à l'orage, les randonneurs [renoncent] à gravir la montagne.
items.sen: Faced with the storm, the hikers give up climbing the mountain.
items.szh: 面对雷雨，徒步者们放弃了登山。
items.scene: Two friendly clay cartoon hikers decisively turn away from a mountain path and head back toward a nearby sheltered valley. Keep their turning movement central, with a dark rain cloud over the distant summit clearly explaining why they abandon the climb; no frightening weather close to the characters. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 看见山顶雷雨，决定不登山：renoncer à，放弃原计划。

items.fr: Malgré sa peur, Zoé [ose] caresser le grand cheval.
items.sen: Despite her fear, Zoé dares to stroke the big horse.
items.szh: 尽管害怕，佐伊还是敢伸手抚摸那匹大马。
items.scene: A small cartoon girl takes a brave first step toward a large, gentle horse and cautiously touches its broad nose. Her slightly hesitant posture and determined smile contrast with the horse's calm lowered head; use crisp visible pixel blocks and a simple sunny paddock. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 害怕却仍然伸出手，就是 oser：敢于做。

items.extra: hésiter à + inf. / entre deux possibilités
items.fr: Au marché, Hugo [hésite] entre les pommes et les poires.
items.sen: At the market, Hugo hesitates between the apples and the pears.
items.szh: 在市场上，雨果在苹果和梨之间犹豫不决。
items.scene: A cartoon shopper stands between equally tempting baskets of red apples and yellow pears, looking from one to the other with his hand hovering undecided between them. Use bold retro shapes and expressive body language with a clear central choice, but no price labels, lettering or poster typography. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 手在苹果与梨之间停住：hésiter entre，在两者之间犹豫。

items.fr: Léa [convainc] son frère de porter un casque avant de partir.
items.sen: Léa convinces her brother to wear a helmet before leaving.
items.szh: 莱娅说服弟弟出发前戴上头盔。
items.scene: In a simple isometric cartoon courtyard, a sister points encouragingly to a bicycle helmet while her brother agrees and starts putting it on. Keep their faces, persuasive gesture and helmet large and central, with his bicycle parked alongside and no written dialogue. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 姐姐劝一劝，弟弟终于戴上头盔：convaincre quelqu'un de faire。

items.fr: Malgré son sac lourd, Mamie [insiste] pour porter aussi le gâteau.
items.sen: Despite her heavy bag, Grandma insists on carrying the cake as well.
items.szh: 尽管袋子很重，奶奶还是坚持要把蛋糕也一起拿着。
items.scene: A confident cartoon grandmother already carrying a bulging shopping bag repeatedly reaches out her free hand for the cake held by an adult relative. Show her determined but friendly expression and the relative's mildly hesitant response, with the cake as the single bright accent in an otherwise monochrome ink scene. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 已经提着重袋子，还坚持要拿蛋糕：insister pour，坚持要做。
items.style: ink wash with one accent colour

items.fr: Pendant l'orage, le père [rassure] sa fille en lui tenant la main.
items.sen: During the storm, the father reassures his daughter by holding her hand.
items.szh: 雷雨时，父亲握着女儿的手，让她安心。
items.scene: A caring cartoon father sits beside his daughter indoors and gently holds her hand as her worried face relaxes. Their joined hands and calm expressions dominate the composition, while a small window shows distant rain and a mild lightning flash outside. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 握住手，让害怕的人安心：rassurer，使人放心。

items.fr: Lina [encourage] son frère à pédaler sans les petites roues.
items.sen: Lina encourages her brother to pedal without training wheels.
items.szh: 莉娜鼓励弟弟骑车时不再使用辅助轮。
items.scene: A cartoon sister walks beside her younger brother on a small bicycle without training wheels, cheering with a broad smile and an encouraging thumbs-up. Centre the boy making his first confident pedal strokes, wearing a helmet on a smooth empty park path. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 在旁边加油，让弟弟敢骑下去：encourager quelqu'un à faire。

items.fr: Sur le banc, Zoé [se confie] à son amie attentive.
items.sen: On the bench, Zoé confides in her attentive friend.
items.szh: 坐在长椅上，佐伊向认真倾听的朋友倾诉。
items.scene: Two cartoon friends sit close together on a quiet park bench, one speaking softly with a hand over her heart while the other leans in and listens with warm attention. Focus on their intimate conversation and supportive body language, with a softly washed background and no speech bubbles. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 把心里的话交给可信的朋友：se confier à，向某人倾诉。

items.fr: Après leur dispute, les sœurs [se réconcilient] avec un grand câlin.
items.sen: After their argument, the sisters make up with a big hug.
items.szh: 争吵过后，姐妹俩用一个大大的拥抱和好了。
items.scene: Two cartoon sisters embrace warmly after a disagreement, their slightly apologetic faces softening into relieved smiles. Fill the centre with the unmistakable mutual hug and relaxed hands, against a simple softly coloured bedroom background. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 吵过架后重新拥抱：se réconcilier，和好。

items.fr: Les voisins [accueillent] la nouvelle famille avec une tarte maison.
items.sen: The neighbours welcome the new family with a homemade pie.
items.szh: 邻居们用一份自制馅饼欢迎新搬来的家庭。
items.scene: Friendly cartoon neighbours offer a freshly baked pie at the open doorway of a family's new home. Centre the welcoming smiles and the shared pie, with a few plain unpacked moving boxes behind the arriving family to establish the move. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 带着自制馅饼来迎接新邻居：accueillir，欢迎接待。

items.fr: Lina [rejoint] ses amis qui l'attendent au bord du lac.
items.sen: Lina joins her friends who are waiting for her beside the lake.
items.szh: 莉娜来到湖边，与等着她的朋友们会合。
items.scene: A cartoon woman arrives along a lakeside path and waves as she steps into the waiting group of friends. Keep the approaching woman and the friends welcoming her into their circle prominent, with a small calm lake and a simple picnic blanket behind them. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 从独自走来，到进入朋友的圈子：rejoindre，与人会合。

items.extra: s'installer dans un logement / dans un fauteuil / à une table
items.fr: Après le déménagement, Léa [s'installe] confortablement dans son nouveau fauteuil.
items.sen: After the move, Léa settles comfortably into her new armchair.
items.szh: 搬家后，莱娅舒舒服服地坐进了她的新扶手椅。
items.scene: A relaxed cartoon woman lowers herself comfortably into a large new armchair, leaning back with a contented smile. Surround her with only a few plain moving boxes to establish her new home, keeping the settling-in gesture and cosy chair dominant in a three-colour linocut composition. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 搬完家，终于安顿下来坐舒服：s'installer。

items.fr: Le garçon [s'éloigne] de l'eau pendant que la vague approche.
items.sen: The boy moves away from the water's edge as the wave approaches.
items.szh: 海浪涌来时，男孩往远离水边的方向走去。
items.scene: A friendly clay cartoon boy steps briskly inland on a sandy beach as a small gentle wave rolls toward the shoreline behind him. Make his body and footprints clearly lead away from the water, with a calm expression and plenty of dry sand ahead; the scene remains safe and playful. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 脚印朝岸上延伸，离水边越来越远：s'éloigner de。

items.extra: s'abriter de la pluie / sous un toit
items.fr: Pendant l'averse, les cyclistes [s'abritent] sous le toit d'une grange.
items.sen: During the downpour, the cyclists take shelter under the roof of a barn.
items.szh: 阵雨中，骑行者们躲在谷仓的屋檐下避雨。
items.scene: Two friendly pixel-art cyclists stand dry beneath the deep overhanging roof of a small barn, their bicycles parked beside them. Contrast the protected central figures with clear diagonal rain outside the roof edge, using crisp pixel blocks and an uncluttered rural setting. Landscape 3:2; no text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks.
items.hook: 屋檐外下雨，屋檐下干燥：s'abriter，找地方避雨。

items.extra: se précipiter vers qch / pour + inf.
items.fr: Zoé [se précipite] vers la porte pour accueillir sa grand-mère.
items.sen: Zoé rushes to the door to welcome her grandmother.
items.szh: 佐伊急忙跑向门口，迎接她的奶奶。
items.scene: A cheerful cartoon girl rushes toward an open front door, her feet mid-stride and her arms opening for a hug. Her smiling grandmother waits just outside with a small overnight bag; the rushing girl dominates the bright, uncluttered composition.
items.hook: 看到门口的奶奶就飞奔过去：se précipiter vers，急忙奔向。

items.en: to lean on; to rely on
items.fr: Le randonneur fatigué [s'appuie] sur son bâton au sommet.
items.sen: The tired hiker leans on his walking stick at the summit.
items.szh: 疲惫的徒步者在山顶倚着手杖。
items.scene: At a gentle mountain summit, a tired cartoon hiker rests both hands and his upper body on a sturdy walking stick planted firmly on the ground. His slumped shoulders and bent elbows make the support unmistakable, with only a distant mountain silhouette behind him.
items.hook: 把身体的重量交给手杖：s'appuyer sur，倚靠在……上。

items.extra: se pencher pour + inf. / sur qch
items.en: to bend down; to lean over
items.fr: Lina [se penche] pour ramasser sa clé tombée sous la table.
items.sen: Lina bends down to pick up her key that fell under the table.
items.szh: 莉娜俯下身，捡起掉在桌子下面的钥匙。
items.scene: A cartoon woman bends deeply at the waist beside a simple table, reaching toward one oversized key on the floor beneath it. Use a clear side view that emphasizes her bent posture and the gap between her fingertips and the key.
items.hook: 钥匙掉到桌下，先弯下身再捡：se pencher pour，俯身去做。
items.style: ink wash with one accent colour

items.en: to put up with; to bear
items.fr: Paul [supporte] difficilement le bruit du tambour de sa sœur.
items.sen: Paul finds it hard to put up with the noise of his sister's drum.
items.szh: 保罗很难忍受妹妹敲鼓的声音。
items.scene: A cartoon boy at a small desk winces and presses his hands over his ears while his sister enthusiastically beats a toy drum nearby. Make the boy's strained but non-angry expression the focal point, using a few simple curved vibration marks around the drum and no written sound effects.
items.hook: 听着鼓声捂住耳朵，仍在勉强忍受：supporter。

items.fr: Nous [soulevons] le canapé pour retrouver le ballon du chien.
items.sen: We lift the sofa to find the dog's ball.
items.szh: 我们抬起沙发，寻找狗狗的球。
items.scene: Two friendly cartoon adults lift opposite ends of a small sofa just high enough to reveal a bright ball underneath. An excited dog crouches beside the gap, and the raised sofa legs and visible ball keep the lifting action immediately readable.
items.hook: 沙发抬离地面，下面的小球露出来：soulever，抬起。

items.fr: Le chat [renverse] le bol de lait avec sa queue.
items.sen: The cat knocks over the bowl of milk with its tail.
items.szh: 猫咪用尾巴打翻了牛奶碗。
items.scene: A surprised cartoon cat has just swept its tail against a bowl on a kitchen table. The bowl tilts onto its side as a broad splash of milk spills across the tabletop, with the tail clearly touching its rim.
items.hook: 尾巴一甩，碗倒了、奶洒了：renverser。

items.fr: Léa [rattrape] son frère en courant le long du canal.
items.sen: Léa catches up with her brother by running along the canal.
items.szh: 莱娅沿着运河奔跑，追上了哥哥。
items.scene: A cartoon young woman runs along a wide canal path and is just drawing level with her walking brother, who turns toward her with a smile. Her forward stride and his relaxed walking posture show that she has caught up; keep both figures safely away from the water.
items.hook: 别人走在前面，你跑到他身边：rattraper，追上。

items.fr: À l'aéroport, Emma [récupère] sa valise sur le tapis roulant.
items.sen: At the airport, Emma collects her suitcase from the conveyor belt.
items.szh: 在机场，艾玛从行李传送带上取回自己的行李箱。
items.scene: A cheerful cartoon traveller lifts a distinctive yellow suitcase off an airport baggage carousel with both hands on its handle. The suitcase is halfway off the moving belt, and the simple background contains no airport signs, labels or writing.
items.hook: 行李转回来，伸手取回自己的箱子：récupérer。

items.fr: Le père [répartit] les parts de pizza entre ses enfants.
items.sen: The father distributes the pizza slices among his children.
items.szh: 爸爸把披萨分给孩子们。
items.scene: A smiling cartoon father distributes pizza slices onto the plates of his children around a small table. Show one slice being placed on the last empty plate while the other children already have matching slices, making the fair distribution easy to grasp.
items.hook: 每人盘里都分到一块：répartir entre，分配给……。

items.fr: Nous [trions] les déchets en séparant le papier des bouteilles.
items.sen: We sort the rubbish by separating paper from bottles.
items.szh: 我们把纸和瓶子分开，对垃圾进行分类。
items.scene: Two friendly cartoon neighbours sort clean recyclable rubbish into two open containers, placing crumpled paper with paper and empty bottles with bottles. Keep the contents fully visible and use no bin labels, symbols or text, so the matching materials explain the action.
items.hook: 纸归纸，瓶子归瓶子：trier，把东西分类。

items.fr: Je [me débarrasse] de cette chaise cassée à la déchèterie.
items.sen: I get rid of this broken chair at the recycling centre.
items.szh: 我在废物回收站处理掉这把坏椅子。
items.scene: A cartoon adult at a tidy recycling centre places a broken wooden chair with one detached leg into a low open container for damaged wooden furniture. Their relieved expression and hands releasing the chair make the act of getting rid of it central, with no signs or lettering.
items.hook: 把占地方的坏椅子送去回收：se débarrasser de，处理掉。

items.fr: Lina [améliore] son dessin en ajoutant des couleurs plus vives.
items.sen: Lina improves her drawing by adding brighter colours.
items.szh: 莉娜添加更鲜艳的颜色，让自己的画变得更好。
items.scene: A focused cartoon girl uses a bright crayon to improve a large flower drawing spread across her desk. The area she has coloured is vivid and lively while the unfinished side remains a faint pencil outline; show her hand adding a saturated petal, with no writing anywhere.
items.hook: 让原来的画变得更好、更鲜亮：améliorer，改善。

items.fr: La baignoire [déborde] parce que le robinet est resté ouvert.
items.sen: The bathtub overflows because the tap was left running.
items.szh: 浴缸溢水了，因为水龙头一直开着。
items.scene: In a friendly cartoon bathroom, water visibly runs from an open tap into a full bathtub and cascades over the near rim onto the floor. A surprised adult in slippers reaches toward the tap from dry ground; the overflowing edge takes centre stage.
items.hook: 水装满以后越过边缘流出来：déborder，溢出。

items.fr: Je [réduis] ma consommation d'eau en fermant le robinet pendant le brossage des dents.
items.sen: I reduce my water consumption by turning off the tap while brushing my teeth.
items.szh: 我刷牙时关掉水龙头，减少用水量。
items.scene: A cartoon adult brushes their teeth with one hand while the other turns a bathroom tap fully off. A final drop hangs from the spout above an otherwise dry basin, clearly emphasizing water saved by stopping the flow; keep the toothbrush and tap large and easy to see.
items.hook: 刷牙时拧紧水龙头，用水变少：réduire，减少。

items.fr: Maya [gère] son budget en répartissant ses pièces dans plusieurs bocaux.
items.sen: Maya manages her budget by dividing her coins among several jars.
items.szh: 玛雅把硬币分放进几个罐子里，管理自己的预算。
items.scene: A thoughtful cartoon woman sits at a neat table and deliberately divides a small pile of plain coins among several transparent jars. A grocery basket, a small model house and a piggy bank sit beside different jars to suggest spending needs and savings, with no currency marks, numbers or written labels.
items.hook: 把钱按用途安排好：gérer son budget，管理预算。
items.style: ink wash with one accent colour

items.fr: Le chat [interrompt] ma lecture en sautant sur mon livre.
items.sen: The cat interrupts my reading by jumping onto my book.
items.szh: 猫咪跳到我的书上，打断了我的阅读。
items.scene: A playful cartoon cat lands across an open book in a seated reader's lap, completely blocking the pages. The reader pauses with raised eyebrows and hands lifted slightly away; keep the pages blank and the cat's interruption at the centre of the image.
items.hook: 正读着书，猫跳上来让阅读停住：interrompre，打断。

items.extra: reporter une activité / reporter qch à plus tard
items.fr: Elle [reporte] le pique-nique à cause de la pluie.
items.sen: She postpones the picnic because of the rain.
items.szh: 因为下雨，她推迟了野餐。
items.scene: A cartoon woman at home looks out at heavy rain while closing her packed picnic basket and setting the folded picnic blanket aside. Her disappointed but calm expression and the picnic supplies being put away make the postponed outing clear, with no calendars, numerals or writing.
items.hook: 下雨了，先把野餐篮收起来，改天再去：reporter，推迟。

items.extra: remplacer qch par qch / remplacer qn
items.fr: Paul [remplace] la roue abîmée de son vélo par une neuve.
items.sen: Paul replaces his bicycle's damaged wheel with a new one.
items.szh: 保罗用一个新车轮替换了自行车的坏车轮。
items.scene: A cartoon man fits a clean new wheel into the front fork of an upside-down bicycle. The old wheel, clearly bent and with a flat tyre, lies beside him, making the replacement visible in a single uncluttered workshop scene.
items.hook: 坏轮子卸下来，新轮子装上去：remplacer quelque chose par，拿……替换。

items.fr: Les voisins [s'entraident] pour monter une grande armoire dans le salon.
items.sen: The neighbours help each other assemble a large wardrobe in the living room.
items.szh: 邻居们互相帮助，在客厅里组装一个大衣柜。
items.scene: Two friendly cartoon neighbours cooperate to assemble a large wooden wardrobe in a bright living room. One holds a tall side panel steady while the other fastens a shelf, with their complementary actions and shared smiles clearly showing mutual help; no instruction sheets or text are visible.
items.hook: 一个扶住木板，一个拧紧螺丝：s'entraider，互相帮助。

items.extra: se renseigner sur qch auprès de qn
items.fr: La voyageuse [se renseigne] sur les sentiers auprès du guide.
items.sen: The traveller asks the guide for information about the trails.
items.szh: 这位女游客向导游打听徒步路线。
items.scene: A cartoon traveller with a small backpack consults a friendly guide beside a trail entrance. She points to a branching path on a simple wordless map while the guide indicates the matching trail in the landscape, making the exchange of practical information clear.
items.hook: 出发前向导游问清路线：se renseigner sur，打听关于……的信息。

items.fr: Léa est [déçue] : sa glace vient de tomber par terre.
items.sen: Léa is disappointed: her ice cream has just fallen on the ground.
items.szh: 莱娅很失望：她的冰淇淋刚刚掉到了地上。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon girl holds an empty ice-cream cone and looks down with slumped shoulders at the colourful scoop on the pavement. Her disappointed face, the empty cone and the fallen scoop form one large central group against a simple sunny park background.
items.hook: 满心期待的冰淇淋掉了，期待落空的表情就是 déçu。

items.fr: Paul est [enthousiaste] à l'idée de planter son premier potager.
items.sen: Paul is excited about planting his first vegetable garden.
items.szh: 一想到要种自己的第一个菜园，保罗就兴奋不已。
items.scene: A cheerful cartoon man beams with wide eyes beside a small empty vegetable bed, holding a hand trowel while eagerly leaning toward a tray of leafy seedlings. His energetic pose and the ready-to-plant seedlings dominate the composition, with a simple garden fence behind him.
items.hook: 还没开始种菜就跃跃欲试，enthousiaste 是充满热情。

items.fr: Cette couturière [rigoureuse] vérifie chaque couture avant de terminer la veste.
items.sen: This meticulous seamstress checks every seam before finishing the jacket.
items.szh: 这位一丝不苟的女裁缝在完成外套前会检查每一道缝线。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon seamstress carefully examines a jacket seam through a magnifying glass, keeping the fabric neatly spread across her worktable. Make the precise row of stitches and her concentrated expression large and clear, with neatly arranged plain sewing tools and no printed markings.
items.hook: 连每一道缝线都仔细检查，rigoureux 强调严谨细致。

items.fr: Il reste [réticent] à goûter cette soupe pourtant délicieuse.
items.sen: He remains reluctant to taste this soup, even though it is delicious.
items.szh: 尽管这汤很好喝，他还是不太愿意尝。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon man leans slightly away from a steaming bowl of green soup, lips closed and one palm gently raised while the other hand hesitates over a spoon. Across the small table, a friend enjoys the same soup with a delighted smile; keep the reluctant man and his bowl as the clear focus.
items.hook: 面对邀请仍往后缩一点，réticent 表示心里有顾虑、不太情愿。

items.fr: Ce serveur [maladroit] laisse tomber les oranges de son plateau.
items.sen: This clumsy waiter drops the oranges from his tray.
items.szh: 这位笨手笨脚的服务员把托盘里的橙子弄掉了。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon waiter tilts a tray accidentally, sending several bright oranges tumbling toward the floor while he tries to catch them. Make the tilted tray, falling oranges and his surprised but unharmed face the large central action in a simple café interior.
items.hook: 盘子一歪、橙子乱滚，maladroit 就是动作不灵巧。

items.fr: Mon frère [distrait] verse du jus dans son bol de céréales.
items.sen: My absent-minded brother pours juice into his bowl of cereal.
items.szh: 我那心不在焉的兄弟把果汁倒进了麦片碗里。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon young man gazes out of a kitchen window while unknowingly pouring bright orange juice from a clear jug into a bowl of cereal. Make the orange stream and cereal bowl unmistakable, with a plain milk jug left untouched nearby and no packaging or labels.
items.hook: 眼睛看窗外，手却把果汁倒进麦片里：distrait 是心不在焉。

items.fr: Son bureau [désordonné] disparaît sous les papiers et les chaussettes.
items.sen: His messy desk disappears under papers and socks.
items.szh: 他那张凌乱的书桌被纸张和袜子淹没了。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon study desk is almost buried beneath a jumble of completely blank papers and scattered socks, with just the desk edges and legs visible. Use a strong readable silhouette and one accent colour on the socks; keep the rest of the room simple so the disorder is the whole subject.
items.hook: 连桌面都找不到了，désordonné 就是没有条理、乱糟糟。
items.style: ink wash with one accent colour

items.fr: Un visiteur [inattendu] nous attend : un hérisson dort dans notre panier.
items.sen: An unexpected visitor awaits us: a hedgehog is sleeping in our basket.
items.szh: 一位意想不到的访客在等着我们：一只刺猬睡在我们的篮子里。
items.scene: Two friendly cartoon adults peek into a picnic basket with raised eyebrows and delighted surprise, discovering a small hedgehog curled up asleep inside. The open basket and sleeping hedgehog fill the foreground, while the surprised faces frame them against a quiet garden background.
items.hook: 篮子里竟然睡着小刺猬，inattendu 是事先没有料到的。

items.fr: Cette bouilloire [défectueuse] laisse couler l'eau par une fissure.
items.sen: This faulty kettle lets water leak through a crack.
items.szh: 这个有缺陷的水壶从一道裂缝里漏水。
items.scene: A plain stovetop kettle sits off the stove on a cool kitchen counter, leaking a clear stream of water through a visible crack in its side. Centre the large kettle and growing puddle, with a friendly cartoon hand pointing at the faulty seam and no steam, electricity or labels.
items.hook: 水从不该漏的裂缝流出来，défectueux 表示物品有故障或缺陷。

items.fr: Cette chaise est [disponible] : tu peux t'asseoir à côté de moi.
items.sen: This chair is free: you can sit next to me.
items.szh: 这把椅子空着：你可以坐在我旁边。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon woman seated at a small café table smiles and gestures invitingly toward the empty chair right beside her as her friend approaches. Make that free chair large and unobstructed, with other occupied tables suggested softly in the background and no signs or writing.
items.hook: 椅子空着可以坐，disponible 也可以形容人有空、资源可用。

items.fr: Cette brosse [efficace] enlève toute la boue de mes bottes.
items.sen: This effective brush removes all the mud from my boots.
items.szh: 这把好用的刷子把我靴子上的泥全都刷掉了。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon hand firmly brushes a muddy boot, leaving a broad perfectly clean strip immediately behind the bristles while loose mud falls away. Place an already-clean matching boot beside it and keep the brush, clean surface and remaining mud in a large close-up on a simple background.
items.hook: 刷过就干净，efficace 强调方法或工具确实管用。

items.fr: La montée est [pénible] avec ce gros sac sur le dos.
items.sen: The climb is arduous with this big bag on my back.
items.szh: 背着这个大背包，上坡十分费力。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon hiker trudges up a clearly sloping path with a huge heavy backpack, leaning forward with bent knees and a tired but determined face. Keep the hiker and steep incline large against a bright peaceful hillside, with no cliffs or danger.
items.hook: 大包压背、上坡吃力，pénible 可以形容事情做起来很费劲。

items.fr: Ce fauteuil [encombrant] bloque presque entièrement la porte du salon.
items.sen: This bulky armchair almost completely blocks the living-room doorway.
items.szh: 这把占地方的扶手椅几乎把客厅门口全堵住了。
items.scene: An oversized friendly cartoon armchair fills almost the entire living-room doorway, leaving only a narrow visible gap beside the frame. A small adult stands next to it with hands on hips, emphasizing the chair’s cumbersome size; keep the doorway and chair front and centre with a simple room behind.
items.hook: 大到把门都堵住，encombrant 强调占空间、碍手碍脚。

items.fr: Cette réparation [coûteuse] m'oblige à vider ma tirelire presque entièrement.
items.sen: This costly repair forces me to empty almost all the money from my piggy bank.
items.szh: 这次昂贵的维修让我不得不几乎掏空储蓄罐。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon cyclist tips nearly all the coins from a piggy bank into a large pile beside a mechanic, who holds a wrench next to the repaired bicycle. Keep the nearly empty piggy bank and disproportionate coin pile prominent, using completely plain coins without numbers, symbols or lettering.
items.hook: 修一次车，储蓄罐就快空了：coûteux 强调花费很大。

items.fr: Cette passoire est [inutile] pour transporter de l'eau jusqu'au jardin.
items.sen: This colander is useless for carrying water to the garden.
items.szh: 用这个滤篮往花园运水根本没用。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon gardener carries a colander toward nearby thirsty flowerpots, but all the water pours visibly through its holes onto the path before reaching them. Centre the hopelessly leaking colander and the gardener’s bemused expression in a simple sunny garden scene.
items.hook: 拿漏水的滤篮运水，忙了也白忙，这就是 inutile。

items.fr: Il reste [perplexe] devant une chaussure remplie de petits cailloux.
items.sen: He remains puzzled by a shoe filled with small pebbles.
items.szh: 看着一只装满小石子的鞋，他困惑不解。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon man scratches his head and raises one eyebrow while staring into a shoe brimming with small pebbles. Make the inexplicable pebble-filled shoe and puzzled face the dominant pair against a simple hallway background, without question marks or thought bubbles.
items.hook: 鞋里怎么会有石头？这种摸不着头脑的状态就是 perplexe。

items.fr: Cette élève [persévérante] reconstruit sa tour chaque fois qu'elle s'écroule.
items.sen: This persevering student rebuilds her tower every time it collapses.
items.szh: 这位坚持不懈的女学生每次积木塔倒下后都会重新搭起来。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon schoolgirl determinedly stacks a fresh tower of wooden blocks while fallen blocks from the previous collapse lie scattered beside her. Her calm focused face and hand carefully adding the next block show persistence in a single moment, with plain unmarked blocks and a simple classroom background.
items.hook: 积木倒了还继续搭，persévérant 是遇到困难也坚持下去。

items.fr: Mon voisin [généreux] partage toutes ses fraises avec les enfants.
items.sen: My generous neighbour shares all his strawberries with the children.
items.szh: 我慷慨的邻居把他所有的草莓都拿来和孩子们分享。
items.scene: A smiling friendly cartoon neighbour kneels beside a full basket of bright strawberries and generously hands them to a small group of children, who each hold an open bowl. Make his welcoming gesture and the shared fruit central in a simple sunny courtyard, with no packaging or writing.
items.hook: 好东西乐意拿出来分享，généreux 形容人慷慨大方。

items.fr: Cet enfant [autonome] prépare son cartable tout seul avant l'école.
items.sen: This independent child packs his schoolbag all by himself before school.
items.szh: 这个独立的孩子上学前自己整理书包。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon child confidently packs plain books and a pencil case into his open schoolbag on a low table, working entirely on his own. Keep the capable child and neatly organised bag large in a simple bright bedroom, with one accent colour on the bag and completely blank book covers.
items.hook: 不用别人帮忙就能整理好书包，autonome 强调独立完成。
items.style: ink wash with one accent colour

items.fr: Mes chaussons [usés] laissent dépasser mes orteils par de grands trous.
items.sen: My worn-out slippers let my toes poke through large holes.
items.szh: 我的旧拖鞋磨出了大洞，脚趾都露出来了。
items.scene: A friendly cartoon close-up shows a seated person’s feet in old slippers, with toes poking gently through large worn holes at the fronts. Frayed fabric edges and flattened soles make the wear unmistakable against a simple warm floor, with no injury and no text.
items.hook: 穿到脚趾都露出来，usé 表示因使用而磨损。
